target: call_sol.sh — ultra is untouched on the direct transport
cmd: D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort ultra >/dev/null 2>&1; jq -e ".multi_agent.enabled == true and .reasoning.effort == \"high\"" "$D"
